I believe that our actions are not always motivated by internal desires, feelings, or beliefs, but sometimes by external factors like rewards and punishments. I think morality comes from society and cultural norms rather than personal inclinations. I am from Boston, Massachusetts and I enjoy philosophy, reading the news, and playing chess. What is your view on the following topic: Moral motivation
 (A) externalism
 (B) internalism
